free_tier.stated: The first row of the vendor's own VPS table: 2 vCores, 4 GB RAM, 100 GB SSD, 20 TB of bandwidth, at EUR 4.54 per month with IPv6 only or EUR 5.24 per month with a dedicated IPv4. The page states 'Dedicated IP (+EUR 0.70) - IPv6 always included', which is exactly the EUR 0.70 gap between the two figures, and the page's structured data marks the offer set as InStock. The next rows are 4 vCores / 8 GB at EUR 7.98, 4 vCores / 16 GB at EUR 16.14, 8 vCores / 16 GB at EUR 19.51, 16 vCores / 32 GB at EUR 38.63, 16 vCores / 64 GB at EUR 50.02 and 32 vCores / 128 GB at EUR 117.12. Locations offered are Portugal and Czech Republic, with Limassol, Frankfurt, Lisbon, Madrid and Prague named in the footer. The tracker lists the same two prices for Lisbon but gives 30,720 GB a month where the vendor states 20 TB.

egress.terms: 20 TB a month included on every plan; the page advertises no bandwidth overage fees and does not publish a per-TB rate

record.interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
record.tooling: KVM with full root, custom ISO installation and a Plesk panel API named in the navigation; SSH plus the panel, no VPS API documented on the page read
record.chaining: 2 vCores, 4 GB and 100 GB of SSD with 20 TB a month for EUR 4.54 is the best memory-per-euro of the European hosts among evaluated providers, and the 20 TB ceiling is wide enough to run a crawler that also serves bytes.

limits.value: 20 TB a month is the stated allowance on every row of the table; the page claims 'no hidden fees, bandwidth overages, or surprise charges' but publishes no overage rate, so what happens above 20 TB is unverified
